fields.description: Array of step objects. Each step is one of: {"type": "tool", "id", "tool", "args", "continue_on_fail", "retry_on_fail", "max_retries", "wait_between_ms", "wait_seconds"} | {"type": "branch", "id", "condition", "if_true", "if_false"} | {"type": "loop", "id", "condition", "body": [step_id, ...], "max_iterations"} | {"type": "note", "id", "description"} | {"type": "trigger", "id", "trigger_kind": "manual"|"schedule"|"webhook"|"doctype_event"} (declarative only, never executed; must be the first step to be enforced by trigger.py) | {"type": "workflow", "id", "workflow_name", "input_mapping", "continue_on_fail", "retry_on_fail", "max_retries", "wait_between_ms", "wait_seconds"} (calls another Agent Workflow, depth-limited) | {"type": "human_approval", "id", "message"} (pauses the run; resume via resume_workflow). String values inside "args"/"input_mapping" may reference the previous step's output via {{output.field.path}}.
fields.label: Steps (JSON)

fields.description: Optional. If this workflow fails, this workflow is enqueued with {failed_workflow, failed_run, error, log} as its initial input. Leave blank to fail silently (Agent Workflow Run record still gets marked Failed either way).
fields.label: Error Workflow
